dedupe_keys.name: global empirical model of sporadic e occurrence rates

description: GEMSOR estimates the occurrence of blanketing sporadic-E layers from ionosonde and GNSS occultation observations. A reduced-basis reconstruction improves the time representation of those empirical occurrence rates. The resource is documented by Air Force Institute of Technology; United States Air Force Academy. The documented physical domain is Global Ionosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Instant Run. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Low-confidence or poorly observed locations can be represented by zero; zero must not automatically be treated as absence of the phenomenon. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
